source_limitations: Six Oxford publisher pages directly opened 2026-11-03. Cambridge publisher-owned search index snippets observed; direct Cambridge page opens returned HTTP 403 or 520. frozen_snapshot.english_definition: A box designed to store or carry a pair of shoes.
frozen_snapshot.burmese_meaning: ဖိနပ်တစ်စုံကို ထည့်သိမ်းရန် သို့မဟုတ် သယ်ဆောင်ရန် သုံးသော ဖိနပ်ဘူး
frozen_snapshot.example_sentence: She kept the spare shoebox under her bed.

publisher_observation.source_sense_summary: Oxford's literal noun is the box for a pair of new shoes sold or delivered; separate figurative sense is a very small home. Cambridge permits spelling 'shoe box' or 'shoebox'. Frozen 'spare shoebox' is ambiguous and unnatural without context.

frozen_snapshot.english_definition: A small piece of cloth used for washing the face or body.
frozen_snapshot.burmese_meaning: မျက်နှာ သို့မဟုတ် ကိုယ်ခန္ဓာ သန့်စင်ရာတွင် သုံးသော အဝတ်စငယ်
frozen_snapshot.example_sentence: He used a clean washcloth to wipe his face after the match.

publisher_observation.source_sense_summary: Oxford explicitly marks 'washcloth' North American English and gives British 'flannel' and 'facecloth'. Cambridge also labels US. frozen_snapshot.english_definition: A building with glass walls where plants grow in warm conditions.
frozen_snapshot.burmese_meaning: အပင်များကို နွေးထွေးစွာ စိုက်ပျိုးရန် မှန်ဖြင့်ကာရံထားသော အဆောက်အအုံ
frozen_snapshot.example_sentence: They grow tomatoes in a greenhouse during the colder months.

publisher_observation.source_sense_summary: Oxford greenhouse is a glass-sided and glass-roofed plant-growing structure. Cambridge indexes the same literal structure, without a displayed CEFR badge. Oxford Buildings/Gardens/Farming b2 labels are TOPIC levels, not proof that the word itself is B2 or A2. Distinguish greenhouse gas/effect phrases.

frozen_snapshot.english_definition: A small cart with one wheel used to move heavy things by hand.
frozen_snapshot.burmese_meaning: ပစ္စည်းလေးများကို လက်ဖြင့်တွန်းသယ်ရန် သုံးသော ဘီးတစ်လုံးပါ လှည်းငယ်
frozen_snapshot.example_sentence: The gardener used a wheelbarrow to carry soil across the yard.

publisher_observation.source_sense_summary: Oxford describes a large open container with a wheel and two handles for carrying things outdoors. Frozen 'small cart' may mislead size and form; Myanmar 'ပစ္စည်းလေးများ' can mean small/light objects rather than heavy loads. Oxford 'Gardens c2' is a TOPIC label, not a word-level CEFR C2.
